user.title: Add a Philips PureProtect air purifier
user.description: Home Assistant can look for the air purifier on your network, or you enter its address yourself.

search.title: Air purifiers found
search.description: Choose the air purifier to add. Give it a fixed address in your router, so that it stays reachable.

manual.title: Enter the address
manual.description: Enter the address of the air purifier on your network. You can find it in your router. Give the purifier a fixed address there, so that it stays reachable.

discovery_confirm.title: Air purifier found
discovery_confirm.description: {name} ({model}) was found on your network at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant?

reconfigure.title: Change the address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the air purifier. Home Assistant checks that it is the same device.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at this address. Check the address, and that the purifier has power and is on your Wi-Fi network.
error.not_a_purifier: Something answered at this address, but it is not a Philips air purifier. Check the address.
error.no_devices_found: No air purifier answered on your network. Check that it has power and is on your Wi-Fi, or enter its address. You can find it in your router.
error.no_new_devices: Every air purifier that answered is already set up. To add another one, check that it has power and is on your Wi-Fi, or enter its address. You can find it in your router.

abort.already_configured: This air purifier is already set up. Its address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: Another air purifier answers at this address. The address was not changed.
abort.not_a_purifier: The device that was found is not a Philips air purifier.

device_off.message: {name} is switched off and ignores settings while it is off. Switch it on first.

refused.message: {name} refused the command. This can happen when another program on the Home Assistant computer talks to the purifier at the same time, for example an older integration for this purifier. Disable that one and try again.

not_confirmed.message: {name} accepted the command but did not report the change. If the purifier is off, switch it on first. Otherwise this model probably does not take this setting from the network; use the Air+ app or the buttons on the purifier instead.

unreachable.message: {name} did not answer. Check that the purifier has power and is connected to your Wi-Fi network, and try again.

wrong_device.message: Another device answers at the address of {name}. Nothing was sent.

filter_interval_unknown.message: {name} does not report how many hours a filter cleaning lasts, so the counter cannot be set back.

filter_life_unknown.message: {name} does not report how many hours a filter lasts, so the counter cannot be set back.

wrong_device.title: Another device answers at the address of {name}
wrong_device.description: The device at {host} is not the air purifier that was set up as {name}. Its address has probably changed. Look up the new address in your router and choose Reconfigure on the integration to enter it. Until then the purifier is shown as unavailable.
